COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SAF_clear = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SAF_clear_tt
		country_exists = SAF
		NOT = { has_war_with = SAF }
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SAF }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SAF }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SAF }
			}
		}
		SAF = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = ZIM }
			NOT = { is_embargoing = ZIM }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = ZIM }
